## Problem
The AMIP dashboard crashed on startup (502 since Nov 5) after new coupler output arrived. Every `clima_land` variable now has a `DateTime` time axis (CF date units decoded by NCDatasets), and `ClimaAnalysis.dates` — still as of v0.5.25 — only handles numeric seconds since `start_date`:

```
MethodError: no method matching time_to_date(::DateTime, ::DateTime)
  ClimaAnalysis.dates → _detect_native_period → available_levels → precompute_dashboard_cache → dashboard
```

## Fix
Add `_numeric_time_axis(var)` and call it at the top of `to_display_units`, which every sim-variable load path goes through (`load_sim_var`, `precompute_dashboard_cache`). A `DateTime` axis is converted to `Float64` seconds since `start_date` (or since the first date, recorded as `start_date`, when the attribute is missing). Numeric axes are untouched.

## Testing
- All 48 DateTime-axis land variables in the current AMIP run now pass `ClimaAnalysis.dates` and `available_levels`.
- Deployed on the dashboard VM (Julia 1.13.3, ClimaAnalysis 0.5.25): `/amip/` and `/land_longrun/` serve 200 again.

title: Handle DateTime time axes in simulation output
